picks.name: Foodman
picks.source_note: Already in your library. New label discovery: Hyperdub.
picks.bio: Already in your library. "HIKARIGASASHIKOMU" (July 24, 2026, digital; vinyl August 21) is a Hyperdub album, a direct evolution from his 2023 EP "uchigawa tankentai" -- both introspective and hyperactive, with looped vocals, Japanese children's songs and playground rhymes woven through the productions.
picks.why_listen: A more personal, voice-forward turn from an artist already in your rotation -- good for a set that wants footwork's rhythmic strangeness with a warmer, more human touch.

picks.name: Branko (Various Artists)
picks.source_note: Already in your library. New label discovery: Enchufada (Lisbon).
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Enchufada: A Lisbon Club Story" (April 24, 2026) is a 20-track compilation marking 20 years of Branko's Lisbon label -- 12 archival tracks (Buraka Som Sistema, DJ Marfox's 2013 batida smash "Urban ADN") alongside 8 new ones, including Branko's own "Eventually" (feat. Alex Rita & Bison) and "MPTS" with Pedro da Linha.
picks.why_listen: A hybrid bass/grime/rave sound bridging Afro-diasporic styles -- pairs naturally with your Príncipe picks (DJs Di Guetto, PT Musik) for a full Lisbon-scene stretch of a set.
